name: Zendrop
description:
Zendrop connects Claude to your dropshipping operation so you can run your store through natural conversation.

Browse and search the Zendrop product catalog, check trending products, and estimate shipping costs before you commit. Add catalog products to your import list, customize them, and push them to your connected store.

On the order side, search and filter orders, view full order details with tracking, get cost breakdowns, and fulfill orders directly. Update shipping addresses on unfulfilled orders, cancel orders or specific line items, and pull complete shipment tracking history.

Handle fulfillment problems end to end: view and respond to order issues, reply to suppliers, and process supplier-raised issues that need your action.

Stay on top of the numbers with store performance summaries, order breakdowns by fulfillment status, weekly snapshots, inventory levels, invoices, payment methods, and your current plan and credit balance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zendrop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zendrop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.zendrop.com/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zendrop MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendrop lists 36 MCP tools, including add_my_product, cancel_order, create_order_issue, fulfill_order, get_billing_credit_balance, get_billing_invoices, get_billing_payment_methods, get_billing_plan, get_catalog_categories, get_catalog_product, get_catalog_products, and get_catalog_shipping_estimate.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zendrop?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zendrop in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Zendrop requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zendrop is developed by Zendrop. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
